entries.name: Composure
entries.label: Composure
entries.description: Resists corruption: the Strain of the deep, the bells, the titan's tremors and the nightmares.

entries.name: Max Poise
entries.label: Poise
entries.description: Refills each round. Stagger lowers it; at 0 the unit breaks and loses its action and the rest of its round.
